descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
SUPER OBBY is a bright, bouncy first-person platformer built for VR.

TWENTY LEVELS, TEN WORLDS. Green meadows, autumn, snow, desert, a city skyline far below your feet, candy, volcano over a sea of lava, ocean, sunrise and a rainbow finale with a crate castle. Every level opens with a card that names the world and the new thing to look for.

MOVES THAT FEEL GOOD IN VR. Walk with the left stick, snap-turn with the right, and jump on A with one long, floaty arc tuned for comfort. Hold A for a higher jump. Punch a ? box to pop a coin, or head-bump it from below to shatter it with a thump in both controllers. Land on a walking bomb to squash it.

NEW THINGS AS YOU GO. Forked paths with a high road and a low road that rejoin, bouncy mushrooms, crumbling crate bridges, elevators, launch pads that fling you across the gaps, warp pipes to bonus rooms in the sky, three-way forks, fast bombs, and a hidden star worth ten coins in every later level.

NOTHING EVER KILLS YOU. Fall into a gap or touch the spikes and you hop straight back to the last checkpoint. Best coins and best times are saved for every level so there is always a reason to run it again.

Single player, standing or seated, no internet needed.
